function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The cross-tabulation of `channel` vs `customer_segment` reveals a systematic imbalance: the email channel is heavily skewed toward loyal and returning customers (131 loyal, 131 returning), while the paid_search channel has only 26 loyal and 153 returning.
